d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Mali’s military government under Assimi Goita is doubling down on its strategic alliance with Vladimir Putin, taking delivery of seven new Russian military aircraft—including Mi-24 attack helicopters, Mi-8 transport helicopters, and an Il-76 heavy transport plane—purchased directly with Bamako's national budget. As Mali battles escalating terror attacks from Al-Qaeda-linked JNIM and Islamic State insurgents that reached the heart of the state in 2026, Malian officials say Moscow listens to their security needs, unlike former colonial power France,…
